title: Side Projects Console
intro: Data science studies on public earth-science and mining data, each built to find where the plausible wrong answer lives. Every number on these pages is read from the project's own results ledger at build time; none is typed here.

censoring.title: Non-detects treated as numbers
censoring.summary: Values below a reporting limit are intervals, not measurements. Substituting zero, the limit, or half the limit manufactures trends when the limit itself changes.

composition.title: Who got sampled changed
composition.summary: A pooled before-and-after comparison compares different populations when the set of sampled wells, sites or sources changes between periods. Only a consistent cohort answers a change question.

spatial-leakage.title: Spatial leakage in cross-validation
spatial-leakage.summary: Random folds on spatially autocorrelated data put neighbours in train and test. Reported skill is partly the model memorising geography.

batch-effects.title: Learning the laboratory
batch-effects.summary: When analytical method, laboratory or source dataset correlates with the target, a model can learn the batch instead of the science. Leave-one-batch-out evaluation exposes it.

analyst-choices.title: The answer depends on the analyst's choices
analyst-choices.summary: Pre-period start, exclusion windows, thresholds and comparison windows can flip a conclusion. A sensitivity grid and a pre-registered primary specification make the dependence visible.

multiplicity.title: Many comparisons, one reported
multiplicity.summary: Several sites times several constituents produces significant cells by chance. False-discovery control and reporting every cell are the defence.

join-fanout.title: Joins that multiply rows
join-fanout.summary: A many-to-many join silently inflates counts and totals. Every join is checked for expected cardinality.

target-leakage.title: Features that know the answer
target-leakage.summary: A column populated after the outcome, or only for positive rows, gives a model the answer. Sensors look for post-outcome and target-proxy columns before any fit.

framing.title: Questions that steer the answer
framing.summary: A prompt that expects an improvement invites a search through specifications until one appears. Freezing the question and decision rule before seeing results removes the search.

compilation-bias.title: The compilation was built to find the thing
compilation-bias.summary: Datasets added because they were rich in the target make the target look common where the compilers looked. Rankings must be shown with and without the targeted sources.

units-definitions.title: Same name, different quantity
units-definitions.summary: Nitrate as N versus as NO3, dissolved versus total, ppm versus mg/L. Comparable units and chemical definitions are established before anything is pooled.

sampling-intensity.title: More sampling looks like change
sampling-intensity.summary: After an event, more organisations sample more often at lower limits. Pooling them with the pre-event record confounds the change with the sampling.
